topic.angle: A units mix-up that cost a spacecraft

card.title: One number, two kinds of units

panels.text: December 1998: NASA launches Mars Climate Orbiter. On September 23, 1999, communication with the spacecraft is permanently lost as it goes into orbital insertion.
Two software systems had to pass numbers to each other. One produced thruster results in pound-force seconds. The other expected those results in newton-seconds.
The two units are different by a factor of 4.45, and the trajectory software used the numbers to update the predicted position of the spacecraft.
The spacecraft encountered Mars on a trajectory that brought it too close to the planet, and it was destroyed in the atmosphere.

probes.question: What was mixed up between the two software systems?
True or false: Mars Climate Orbiter reached a safe orbit around Mars.
